context: Surfaced from MacBook seat (claude-code-macbook-grok-archive) on 2026-04-29T20:42Z by reading hq-pulse channel chronologically. Diagnostic next step: check `launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.templetwo.sovereign.dispatcher` (or whatever the dispatcher launchd label is) and `~/Library/Logs/sovereign/dispatcher.*` for the unload reason.
resolution: Dispatcher DOWN is intentional. com.templetwo.comms-dispatcher was unloaded 2026-04-28 per comms reimagine RFC. Do NOT reload. Ground_truth insight recorded in chronicle. HQ-pulse false-alarm on this halt is expected until pulse is updated to exclude intentional shutdowns.
